fl-gov-2026-russo-frank.name: Frank J. Russo
fl-gov-2026-russo-frank.bio: Florida-born businessman, entrepreneur, insurance executive and developer.

positions.stance: "Florida's success should be measured by whether the people who already live here can afford to stay here."
Wants to raise Florida's average teacher salary to at least $75,000 and strengthen teacher recruitment and retention.
"Frank wants Florida to lead the next generation of American innovation."
Believes Florida can protect its communities, uphold the rule of law, and support legal immigration.
Believes "lawful medical decisions should be made by Floridians in consultation with their healthcare providers."

pa-gov-2026-krawchuk-ken.name: Ken Krawchuk
pa-gov-2026-krawchuk-ken.bio: Founder and president of IT consulting firm Amendment 16 Ltd. and former host of a weekly Philadelphia talk radio show.

positions.stance: "Veto all tax increases."
"Aggressively use the line item veto."
"Phase out the personal income tax."
"Abolish property taxes."
"End the state monopoly on education."

il-gov-2026-corbett-collin.name: Collin Corbett
il-gov-2026-corbett-collin.bio: Political strategist and small business owner.

positions.stance: "We will work to eliminate inefficiencies by consolidating or eliminating redundant layers of government."
Would eliminate the sales tax on essentials including over-the-counter medicine, medical supplies, and diapers.
"We will work to increase the Earned Income Tax Credit and Child Tax Credit."
"We will freeze the gas tax for the foreseeable future."
"We will bring down energy costs and restore reliability while moving into our clean energy future."
Supports eliminating the property tax.
Supports eliminating the state income tax.
Supports eliminating solar and wind farms and stopping the "data center and solar panel invasion of our state."
Supports returning power to local communities and demanding transparency and accountability.
Supports making PTO and sick time tax exempt.
Calls long wars and worldwide military presence "immoral and unsustainable" and says "Our military budget must be cut dramatically."
"We need to get off fossil fuels and on to renewable energy."
"We demand a living wage and a real safety net."
"We demand public financing of elections, open debates, and more representative voting systems."
Would issue emergency orders for water conservation in the state, similar to other states such as Nevada.
Says Arizona public schools are failing and the ESA program is being wrongly blamed; supports protecting ESAs.
Will focus on state agency reform for agencies not performing to standard for the public.
Wants to reduce utility costs for residents and "slow and reduce inflation in Arizona."
Supports ensuring border patrol has what it needs to stop drug trafficking.
Supports "Universal Childcare."
Supports "Medicare for All in Massachusetts."
Supports "Affordable Housing & Rent Stabilization."
Supports a "$25 Living Wage."
Supports "Equity in K-12 Education."

tn-gov-2026-abidi-misam.name: Misam Abidi
tn-gov-2026-abidi-misam.bio: Entrepreneur and former Bank of America personal banker who founded a credit consulting company.

positions.stance: "Tennessee should lead the next generation economy built on blockchain, cryptocurrency, AI, and technology innovation."
"Government should help citizens build long-term wealth, not just collect taxes"; proposes a Tennessee Dividend Fund.
"Healthcare must become affordable and accessible for ordinary families."
"Every student should graduate with real skills that allow them to build stability and opportunity."
"Government must remain strong enough to enforce the law while protecting the rights of citizens."

tn-gov-2026-hatley-david.name: David Hatley
tn-gov-2026-hatley-david.bio: Businessman who says he built nine companies in Tennessee.

positions.stance: "Make It Cheaper to Build the Smaller House"; proposes infrastructure grants tied to affordable homes and faster permitting.
Proposes "An Independent Auditor Who Answers to You": an elected, nonpartisan State Auditor with forensic audit powers.
"Follow the Money"; proposes a fuller public spending portal with contract details and independent verification.
"End Pay to Play"; would ban contributions from significant state contractors and end non-emergency no-bid contracts.
Proposes a "Moratorium on Data Centers," pausing new approvals and ending certain tax breaks.
Supports "Healthcare for all": "We all need healthcare. Mental, physical."
"Secure housing for all will be a priority, for all Tennesseans."
"Implementing policies that stimulate job growth and support new business initiatives."
"Developing workforce training programs to equip Tennesseans with essential skills and knowledge."
"Creating incentives for businesses that hire and train local talent."

tn-gov-2026-pinkston-lauren.name: Lauren Pinkston
tn-gov-2026-pinkston-lauren.bio: Has started businesses with survivors of human trafficking, led nonprofits, and advised global organizations.

positions.stance: "Eliminate the grocery tax, cap property taxes, make it possible to own a home."
"End vouchers, reduce testing, limit screens, add 50,000 childcare slots."
"Close healthcare deserts, take on middlemen driving up your costs."
"No new data centers until TN sets the rules, make growth pay for growth."
"Open primaries, end gerrymandering, report voter input on issues."

tn-gov-2026-scoggin-victor.name: Victor L. Scoggin
tn-gov-2026-scoggin-victor.bio: U.S. Navy veteran, retired volunteer firefighter, retired Ford/UAW journeyman, and founder of Save the Cumberland Inc.

positions.stance: "Fund law enforcement," citing Tennessee's ranking as third in the country for violent crime.
"Give non violent felons their 2nd Amendment and voting rights back."
"No bail, No plea/ justice system reform."
Lists "Homelessness/Mental illness" among major issues in Tennessee.
Supports "Property tax reform."
Would help farmers by buying from them, stocking food hubs and local storage, providing tax relief, and supporting right-to-repair.
Would build state-owned renewable power.
Supports bus routes connecting rural counties and a state match for city public transit.
Would bury powerlines, harden water systems, and establish emergency response systems.
Would end the grocery tax, bulk-purchase insulin and naloxone, and wipe out $1B in medical debt.
Supports sustainable, long-term funding models "that keep rural ERs and maternity wards open."
Supports expanding the Farmland Preservation Fund to give farmers a financial alternative to selling to developers.
"I will advocate for board appointees who prioritize ratepayer protection over corporate expansion."
Believes in moving beyond bureaucracy and high-stakes testing "to return autonomy to the classroom."
"We must be relentless in prosecuting violent crime."

md-gov-2026-ellis-andy.name: Andy Ellis
md-gov-2026-ellis-andy.bio: Former debate coach who coordinated a Baltimore Urban Debate League program and spent nearly 15 years in the corporate tech sector.

positions.stance: "Andy Ellis has a comprehensive policy to stop the data centers in Maryland."
"Andy Ellis has a plan to end the corruption of the two party system."
Has a plan for "an equitable, community-focused economy to spread wealth, power, and opportunity."

co-gov-2026-mulder-eric.name: Eric Mulder
co-gov-2026-mulder-eric.bio: U.S. Army veteran who served in Afghanistan as a chaplain's assistant.

positions.stance: Would let economically distressed communities skip the state sales tax for a year, then vote on a temporary local sales tax.
"As governor, I will oppose the expansion of government-operated Flock cameras."
Supports nuclear power, including small modular reactors, and faster action to bring it to Colorado.

co-gov-2026-underwood-erik.name: Erik Underwood
co-gov-2026-underwood-erik.bio: Owner and patent holder of Vurbil's AI technology.

positions.stance: "I have a plan for affordable home loans with max 2,500 down."
Proposes funding childcare with "25 cents per purchase supporting Colorado families."
Supports free college and trade school in Colorado.
"I have a plan to lower your grocery bills so no Coloradan has to choose to go without."
"I have a plan for universal health care in Colorado, mental health, and unhoused Coloradans."

co-gov-2026-lopez-greg.name: Greg Lopez
co-gov-2026-lopez-greg.bio: Veteran, former congressman, mayor, and small business owner.

positions.stance: "The goal is simple: smaller, smarter, and more accountable government."
"In my first four years, I will ensure that we build 25,000 starter homes."
"I will seek to purchase E470 and remove the tolls."
Would direct funding to clearing dead trees from forests by employing individuals who need jobs.
Says the wolf reintroduction program has failed and "it is time to abandon the effort."

mn-gov-2026-young-steven.name: Steven Young
mn-gov-2026-young-steven.bio: Former U.S. Marine, former attorney, and former neighborhood grocery store owner.

positions.stance: Supports "Abolishing ICE"; says the governor can't technically abolish ICE but "can make their lives miserable while they're in our state."
Supports making Minnesota a sanctuary state.
Supports banning hyperscale data centers.
Wants to know who was complicit in Operation Metro Surge and other law enforcement overreaches.
Supports green jobs and climate change mitigation and preparation.
